line.sourceTitle: Chats that send news to the bot
line.sourceHelp: The bot reads only the chats in this list and reacts to links, CVE ids and pictures. It stays silent in every other chat. To find a chat's ID, add the bot to it and type /chatid.
line.sourceEmpty: No chat yet: the bot reads no messages.
line.destHelp: The bot sends every result to each chat in this list. Results name organizations and devices, so use internal SOC groups, never a customer's group. The bot must be a member of each group.
line.destEmpty: No destination set: the bot answers in the chat the news came from.
line.tenantHelp: Set on the Organizations page. These groups receive only the news that affects their own organization.
line.tenantEmpty: No organization has a LINE group yet.
line.namePlaceholder: Name this chat, e.g. SOC on duty
line.duplicate: This chat ID is already in the list.
line.invalidId: A chat ID is 5 to 64 characters: letters, digits, - and _ only.

chip.sysPartial: {count, plural, one {# organization incomplete} other {# organizations incomplete}}
chip.sysFailed: {count, plural, one {# organization failed} other {# organizations failed}}

system.falconNote: Read-only. Each organization's findings are read from Falcon and saved here.
system.empty: Nothing has been pulled from Falcon yet.
system.dbNote: What was pulled is saved in the portal's own database. Every page reads from here and does not call Falcon each time.
system.cacheNote: Heavy summaries are kept in memory and in the database, so the next person gets the answer at once without recomputing. The higher the hit rate, the faster the pages.
